name: read_console
summary: Read the latest in-game console lines, oldest first: command output, errors and their stack traces. Default 40 lines. Read only.

help.text: On a dedicated server it reads the last 500 lines the game wrote to the server's own console after the mod loaded. run_console_command's background commands print here a moment later.
help.keys: requested_lines, line_count, console_available, lines [{time, level, text}].
